sloka: जङघे भ्^इशमुपन्यस्ते पादौ चाप्यायतावुभौ ।त्वमायताभ्यां सक्थिभ्यां मन्थरे क्षौमवासिनी ।अग्रतो मम गच्छन्ती राजहंसेव भाससे॥२-९-४४॥
transliteration: jaṅaghe bh^iśamupanyaste pādau cāpyāyatāvubhau ।tvamāyatābhyāṁ sakthibhyāṁ manthare kṣaumavāsinī ।agrato mama gacchantī rājahaṁseva bhāsase॥2-9-44॥

translations.english: O Manthara when clad in silk garment you walk in front of me with your heavy thighs, you look like a female royal swan.
